title: Reviewer findings
description: issues/<reviewer issue id>/library/findings.json, written by the reviewer. Only these keys. Missing, not JSON or not this shape: the review is missing. commit differs from the PR head: the review is stale.

commit.description: The commit the reviewer read: 40 lowercase hex digits.

findings.description: One entry per finding. Empty when there is none.

sha.description: A full git commit id: 40 lowercase hex digits.

finding.description: Where a finding is and how heavy it is.

severity.description: trivial when the condition that triggers it cannot be shown concretely.

file.description: Path relative to the repository root: not empty, no control characters, not absolute, no .. segment.

preexisting.description: true when the problem was there before the issue (outside the change). The gate does not count it toward must_fix, unless file:line is a line the PR adds. Absent: false.
